PUBLIC_ORIGIN.description: The exact HTTPS origin of this Worker, for example `https://scheduling.example.com` or its `workers.dev` address. Google sign-in redirects to `<PUBLIC_ORIGIN>/auth/google/callback`.

LIVE_ENABLED.description: Set to `true` once the Google client and encryption key below are set. Leave `false` to keep the service in setup mode.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.description: Client ID of your own Google OAuth **Web application** client with the Google Calendar API enabled. See the Google OAuth section of https://github.com/YCorpLabs/Scheduling/blob/main/docs/self-hosting.md#3-create-the-google-oauth-client.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Client secret of the same Google OAuth web client.

TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: 32 random bytes, base64. Generate with `openssl rand -base64 32` and keep a copy in a password manager: losing it makes stored calendar grants unreadable.

RESEND_API_KEY.description: Optional. Resend API key for booking emails. Leave empty to rely on Google Calendar invitations only.

MAIL_FROM.description: Optional. Sender for booking emails, for example `Scheduling <notifications@example.com>`.
